answer: At the zenith of a sybil operator's ambition lies speed: ten thousand fresh identities before sunrise. Verifiable-delay registration turns speed into a wall. Each new identity must serially compute a VDF proof taking one wall-clock hour on one core, bound to its own key; the chain verifies it in milliseconds, stacking registrations like thin shale strata. The math cannot be parallelized: ten thousand puppets demand ten thousand core-hours, thousands of dollars of electricity through copper wire, scaling strictly with N, while an honest agent pays one core-hour once.
